

# shutdown.exe is all Rust (shutdown-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/shutdown-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# gui.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/shutdown-rust/src/shutdown/gui.rs)
# misc.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/shutdown-rust/src/shutdown/misc.rs)
# shutdown.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/shutdown-rust/src/shutdown/shutdown.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(shutdown_res OBJECT shutdown.rc)
target_compile_definitions(shutdown_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(shutdown_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(shutdown shutdown-cargo shutdown.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE shutdown-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS shutdown_res xdk)
